experiment.hypothesis: A shorter pricing page with one highlighted plan lifts signups.

sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1792232146978
    AND e.ts_ms < 1793874549344
    AND e.event IN ('$exposure', 'signup_completed')
),
x AS (
  SELECT pid, MIN(ts_ms) AS t0, MIN((CASE json_type(props, '$."variant"') WHEN 'true' THEN 'true' WHEN 'false' THEN 'false' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(json_extract(props, '$."variant"') AS TEXT) END)) AS variant, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE json_type(props, '$."variant"') WHEN 'true' THEN 'true' WHEN 'false' THEN 'false' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(json_extract(props, '$."variant"') AS TEXT) END)) AS nv
  FROM ev
  WHERE event = '$exposure' AND (CASE json_type(props, '$."flag"') WHEN 'true' THEN 'true' WHEN 'false' THEN 'false' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(json_extract(props, '$."flag"') AS TEXT) END) = 'pricing-page-v2'
  GROUP BY pid
),
xe AS (SELECT pid, t0, variant FROM x WHERE nv = 1),
g AS (
  SELECT xe.pid, SUM(0) AS total
  FROM xe JOIN ev ON ev.pid = xe.pid
  WHERE ev.event = 'signup_completed' AND ev.ts_ms >= xe.t0 AND 1 = 1
  GROUP BY xe.pid
)
SELECT xe.variant AS variant,
  COUNT(*) AS exposures,
  SUM(CASE WHEN g.pid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS conversions,
  SUM(COALESCE(g.total, 0)) AS value_sum,
  SUM(COALESCE(g.total, 0) * COALESCE(g.total, 0)) AS value_sumsq,
  MIN(xe.t0) AS first_exposure,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM x WHERE nv > 1) AS multi
FROM xe LEFT JOIN g ON g.pid = xe.pid
GROUP BY xe.variant
